<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD is a standard Arch Linux packaging file for abclock, a gtklock-based screen locker. It declares two sources: the package's own upstream tarball (abclock-5.0.6) and a gtklock dependency source (v5.0.0), both from their respective GitHub upstreams with valid SHA256 checksums. The prepare() function applies a local patch to gtklock, and build()/package() use meson/ninja with standard install operations. The PAM configuration installed to /etc/pam.d/gtklock is directly related to the application's authentication purpose. No suspicious commands (curl, wget, eval, base64), no obfuscated code, no exfiltration, and no execution of untrusted external content are present. All activities are consistent with ordinary AUR packaging practices.
</details>
<evidence>
